_comment: Corrections and hand-added places, re-applied on every rebuild. Height rules live in data/venues/cedar-point.heights.json.
_areas_comment: Named areas this venue owns that its own OpenStreetMap polygon does not cover. Cedar Point is mapped as three rings on one peninsula — the amusement park, the water park and the campground — and without this the build reads the latter two as the retail park over the road and drops everything standing in them.

camping._comment: What is true of Lighthouse Point as a whole, from the park's own listing: 145 RV sites, every one of them full hookup with water, sewer, 30/50 amp electric, cable and wi-fi, on a level concrete pad, in back-in and pull-through rows. OpenStreetMap carries the 145 pitch numbers and nothing else about them, so this is where the rest arrives. It sits on the venue rather than on each pitch because that is where the fact lives — a campground is full hookup; a pitch is not individually full hookup. Which pitch is back-in and which is pull-through is not published per number, so it is not written here: `rules` is the place for it if the park ever says.

credits: Height requirements were compiled from published 2026 Cedar Point height charts.
